entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • 10.0-rc1 can't translate a compiled query that 9.0 could #36741
  • I have an Exception Exception "Unable to translate a collection subquery in a projection..." and the exception doesn't have additional information to help in the investigation of the problem #36738

Closed

  • Nav expansion does not handle ExecuteUpdate #32493
    10.0.0
  • EF Core 9 no longer applies COALESCE in SQL translation for DefaultIfEmpty() which causing an InvalidOperationException #35950
    10.0.0
  • Enable the JSON data type and JSON_VALUE() RETURNING clause for Azure SQL #36460
    10.0.0
  • EF Core 10.0: Updating JSON Column in SQL Server: Not using the efficient query #36732
  • Throw when materializating JSON nulls to non-nullable .NET properties #36587
  • Json column has different support for Chinese in addition and editing #30315
    10.0.0
  • Question on release notes EF Core 10: complex/collection updates? #36731
  • Analyzer warnings for string concatenation in raw SQL APIs #35735
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • [rc2] Stop using JSON_VALUE() RETURNING for uniqueidentifier on SQL Server 2025 #36740
    ask-mode
  • Introduce SqlEngineDbContextOptionsBuilderBase to allow unified registration of extension over SQL Server, Azure SQL and Synapse. #36737
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36733

Merged

  • [rc2] Fix issues with primitive collections inside JSON complex types #36723
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix DefaultIfEmpty and nullability within SelectMany selector #36238
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Enable the JSON data type for Azure SQL Database #36739
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Handle escaping in JSON consistently by using JSON_VALUE with JSON_MODIFY #36653
    ask-mode
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #36735
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #36734
  • Small refactoring in analyzer. #36736
    tell-mode
  • Analyzer for string concatenation in raw SQL methods. #36698
    Servicing-approved, ask-mode
  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #36728
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #36727
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36725

Updated

  • [rc2] Revert to stable MSBuild and Roslyn versions #36742
  • [rc2] Support arbitrary values in ExecuteUpdate JSON for SQL Server #36730
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] SQLite: Make AUTOINCREMENT first-class and fix false pending model changes warning for value converters #36717
    ask-mode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36724
  • Use `PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys` instead of `PRAGMA foreign_keys` when migrating #35873
    community-contribution
